reports.title: CAMDEN PROPERTY TRUST ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 OPERATING RESULTS

lines: (1) The Company's 2026 Core FFO guidance excludes approximately $0.60 per share of non-core charges for casualty-related expenses, net of recoveries, legal costs and settlements, expensed transaction, development, and other pursuit costs, and investment losses.
